versions.content: The ADC module shall support result access using the API function Adc_ReadGroup, if the generation of this API function is statically con- figured. Calling Adc_ReadGroup copies the group conversion results of the latest conversion round to an application buffer which start address is specified as API parameter of Adc_ReadGroup.
